Create annotation 0 from token_distribution
Approximately 51 users hold 30% of the token supply, which is highly centralized. Most are marked with red circles, indicating prior suspicious behavior.
Create annotation 1 from token_distribution

Several large, dark-colored nodes are grouped by three orange dashed circles, representing entities detected by the system's rules. These three entities collectively hold substantial funds. Notably, each entity contains at least one account that appears normal alongside several suspicious ones, likely an intentional strategy to maintain a "clean-looking" account.
Create annotation 2 from token_distribution
Two of the three entities, along with several other holders, are connected within a single component (community). This token carries a high manipulation risk and creates a poor initial impression.
Create high-level insight 3 from system
A small number of whales control the vast majority of the circulating supply, while retail holders occupy only peripheral positions.
Create annotation 4 from token_distribution
Top holder 6z6 holds 10M tokens but shows no manipulative behavior.
Create annotation 5 from behavior_details
A whale, but not a manipulator, because tokens were acquired through transfers.
Create annotation 6 from token_distribution
Same-direction manipulation detected, but no entity affiliation.
Create annotation 7 from behavior_details
The holder progressively accumulates tokens; four purchases within a short window triggered a same-direction ramp detection. Upon closer review, this appears to be a normal holder
Create annotation 8 from token_distribution
Located within the flagged component. Frequently buys and transfers out tokens, and appears to be a functional account serving an entity.
Create annotation 9 from behavior_details
Direct transfers to another seemingly normal account are observed, likely used to avoid detection.
Create annotation 10 from behavior_details
Another address bought a similar amount during the same period; the user investigated whether this affected the price and confirmed that it did.
Create annotation 12 from candlestick_chart
This clearly affected the price.
Create annotation 13 from behavior_details
Oct 26, within 32 minutes: 26.17M tokens traded in the same direction. After DMj's sell, 9 addresses buy frequently in the same direction.
Create annotation 14 from behavior_details
Same-direction trading alternates between buys and sells (round-trip pattern).
Create annotation 15 from behavior_details
Visual annotation 15 without text
Create annotation 17 from behavior_details
Three addresses fall within the same connected component.
Create high-level insight 18 from system
These addresses are also part of the same component, forming a large colluding group.
Create annotation 19 from token_distribution
Most of these addresses belong to the identified component.
ACT holder structure is manipulation-prone because supply is concentrated and suspicious holders are linked into entities/components.
Suspicious visual flags require role differentiation: some large or flagged wallets are storage or normal accumulation rather than direct manipulators.
The Oct. 26-27 same-direction card users indicate a larger coordinated manipulation pattern, but individual support differs by wallet.
